caption: The drawing depicts a single iron object centered on a light beige or off-white background. The object is grayish-brown in color and is shaped somewhat like a truncated triangle or trapezoid, with rounded corners at the wider end and three short legs supporting it. The surface of the object is elaborately pierced with a series of circular holes arranged symmetrically along the sides and top, and there is a large teardrop-shaped, open area in the center surrounded by smaller curved and scroll-like cutouts. Toward the bottom edge, a circular decorative element is present. Below the object, on the background, the name "Glenn Wilson" is printed in small, serifed letters. The overall composition is minimal, with the object occupying the upper central portion of the page and no other illustrations or objects shown.
title: Trivet
